snippet.title: Hark The Ghoul Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Hark The Ghoul is a low-poly FPS Soulslike set in an interconnected Victorian city. A new gameplay trailer explored some of the strange environments and esoteric inhabitants you’ll meet on your journey through its monster-filled world. It’s coming soon to PC, but there’s a demo available now.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #harktheghoul

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
